item.title: Reflections on The Temple of the Golden Pavilion: Good and Evil, Beauty and Ugliness, and Emptiness
item.description: Thoughts after reading Yukio Mishima's The Temple of the Golden Pavilion, discussing the relationship between good and evil, beauty and ugliness, emptiness and reality, through the lens of Kinkakuji's protagonist Mizoguchi's inferiority, desire, and destruction.
